title: Extracted gDNA Plate Compression
author: Rodolfo A Salido Benitez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ua4esgw

steps.title: Set up epMotion worktable
steps.instruction: Configure the epMotion 5075 (Liquid Handling, Eppendorf, catalog 5075000962) worktable according to the diagram: place four boxes of 20‑300 µL epT.I.P.S. with filters on deck slots A2, A3, A4 and A5.

steps.title: Load source and destination plates
steps.instruction: Place the four 96‑well gDNA plates on the deck: plates 1‑2 on slots B2‑B3 and plates 3‑4 on slots C2‑C3. Then place a 384‑well polypropylene (PP) or low‑dead‑volume (LDV) destination plate on slot C1.

steps.title: Remove lids and foils
steps.instruction: Take off the lids from the epT.I.P.S. boxes and remove the foil seals from all plates before starting the run.

steps.title: Import protocol into epBlue
steps.instruction: Open epBlue software (version 40.6 or later) and import the file named "Application_gDNA_plate compression_4-96 to 1-384 pp_181003_105135.export6" before attempting execution.

steps.title: Execute automated transfer
steps.instruction: Run the imported protocol; the robot will transfer 60 µL of extracted gDNA from each well of the 96‑well source plates into the corresponding wells of the 384‑well destination plate according to the layout described in the protocol.
